主要内容: The document titled 'Form 6-K' is a regulatory filing by the Royal Bank of Canada, published on February 6, 2012. It is a report of a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, specifically for the month of February 2012. The filing includes information about the Annual Meeting of Common Shareholders and Management Proxy Circular dated January 9, 2012, as well as the form of proxy mailed to common shareholders on February 6, 2012. The filing is submitted under Form 40-F, indicating compliance with U.S. securities regulations. The document is signed by Carol J. McNamara, Vice-President, Associate General Counsel & Secretary of the Royal Bank of Canada.
